titleText: 65-year-old Italian man dies in workplace accident in Ħal Farruġ
mainText: From The Malta Independent: 65-year-old Italian man dies in workplace accident in Ħal Farruġ. A 65-year-old Italian man died Saturday while working at a plant in Triq Ta' Ħal Farruġ, on the outskirts of Siġġiewi, the police said.

mainText: From MaltaToday: Malta eyes Mediterranean tourism safety role under new proposal. Malta has been put forward as a centre for cooperation on visitor safety under a proposal discussed at the 11th Mediterranean Tourism Forum. “This is the basis of sustainable tourism.

titleText: International arrest warrant issued for ex-Steward Health Care boss Ralph de la Torre, court hears
mainText: From The Malta Independent: International arrest warrant issued for ex-Steward Health Care boss Ralph de la Torre, court hears. Maltese authorities have issued an international arrest warrant for Ralph de la Torre, the former Steward Health Care chief who has yet to turn up to face charges over the hospitals deal.
